1439.summary: The class discusses the kingdom of God, emphasizing its joy and glory, and encourages believers to have faith and be worthy of God's kingdom. It covers the role of believers in the future kingdom and the importance of creating a vision of the eternal kingdom to motivate faith and righteous living.

1440.summary: The class discusses the resurrection and judgment of the saints, emphasizing the role of angels in the process and the importance of living a faithful life. It covers the resurrection of the just and the unjust, the role of angels in raising the dead and gathering the living, and the final judgment.

1441.summary: The class explores the concept of immortality and equality with angels, focusing on Philippians 3 and the resurrection. It discusses the transformation of the body into an immortal state, the wisdom and abilities of the saints in the kingdom, and the joy of eternal life.

1442.summary: The class discusses the thousand-year reign of Christ, emphasizing the role of the saints in executing God's judgments and bringing peace to the earth. It highlights the privilege of participating in the subduing of evil and the establishment of God's kingdom, focusing on the spiritual and practical aspects of being king-priests.

1443.summary: The class explores Ezekiel's vision of the temple in the age to come, emphasizing its role as a place of holiness and worship for all nations. It highlights the moral lessons and the importance of holiness for those who will serve in the temple.

1444.summary: The class discusses the stages of God's plan for the millennium, including the return of Christ, resurrection, judgment, and the establishment of God's kingdom. It emphasizes the need for Christians to live worthy lives and be ready for Christ's return.
